newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 25.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:

* "The English Patient" had nine Oscar wins, the most for a single film since "The Last Emperor" in 1987. In the top eight categories, including the acting, writing and directing, the only winner from a big studio was Cuba Gooding Jr., supporting actor winner for Sony's "Jerry Maguire."

* Among distributors, Miramax was the biggest winner Monday night, walking away with exactly half of the Oscar's 24 awards. Among the major studios, Disney's Buena Vista, DreamWorks, Time Warner's Fine Line, News Corp's 20th Century Fox, Viacom's Paramount, Sony Pictures Entertainment and Seagram's Universal each took a single statuette.
